readout_other: pain ratings (0-9); contact heat-evoked potentials; heart-rate variability (SDNN, LF power)
direction_notes: LIFU to AI and PI both reduced pain ratings versus Sham, with differential CHEP effects (PI earlier, AI later amplitudes); only AI altered HRV.
safety_notes: Report of symptoms questionnaire before and 30 min after each session; no severe adverse events or symptoms reported; sleepiness most frequent.

timing.protocol_description: 1 kHz gated burst (N=1000) giving a 1.0 s waveform, time-locked to start 200 ms before each of 40 contact heat stimuli delivered at random 12-20 s intervals.
